no-restricted-syntax.message: Framer Motion type:"spring" is banned (UX_v3.md §1.4). Use --ease-out or --ease-in-out CSS custom properties.
tabIndex is banned unless value is 0 or -1 (UX_v3.md §23.2). Remove it and use natural DOM order.

no-restricted-properties.message: Never store sensitive data (tokens, API keys) in localStorage (UX_v3.md §23.2). Check what you are persisting.
